name: stri_omit_empty
title: Omit empty strings from a character vector

origin.description: Alias of stri_remove_empty. Drops empty strings, and missing values when na_empty is TRUE.

arguments.name: na_empty
arguments.text: Whether missing values should be treated as empty strings.

origin.details: This is stri_remove_empty. Empty strings are removed. Missing values stay unless na_empty is identical to TRUE.

translation.description: Alias of stri_remove_empty. Drops empty strings, and missing values when na_empty is True.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA.

arguments.name: na_empty
arguments.text: Only the boolean True also drops missing values.

translation.details: The same function as stri_remove_empty. An empty string is removed. NA is not empty and stays unless na_empty is True.
translation.value: A list of the kept strings and missing values.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.utils import stri_omit_empty
print(stri_omit_empty(['a', NA, '', 'b']))
